text: Five performers. Five sounds. One song. You heard each other, you didn't change a thing — you went deeper. Now, the seasoned take, given back to the crewman, whole.
Bring it in, bring it in.
Watch it splash, watch it slish.
Lead it 'round like a pet on a leash.
He's reaching for his gaff, and it's only a pink.
We are all watching and waiting.
Crewman — this one's yours, seasoned. Every hand on the line. Good night from the Compass Head Radio Hour.
